title: langgraph dev / Studio crash: get_graph() missing keyword-only arg is_for_execution
author: jessicacardoso

comments.author: hinthornw
comments.body:
Hello! If you bump to a more recent version, does the issue persist?

I believe that langgraph-runtime-inmem 0.21.1 was incompatible with langgraph-api=0.6.20, but we fixded the bounds in 0.6.21 and later

comments.author: DineshThumma9
comments.body:
try to reproduce this issue got same error
after upgrading packages 
langgraph-api==0.6.31
langgraph-runtime-inmem=0.22.0
langgraph==1.0.5
I got no such error

comments.author: jessicacardoso
comments.body:
Confirming that the issue is resolved after upgrading the packages, as suggested.

After the update, LangGraph Studio no longer crashes when inspecting thread history or state, and get_graph() is called correctly.

Thanks for the guidance, closing this issue.
